result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and marked crosswalks, but the environment is dominated by wide vehicle lanes and faded markings. The lack of visible pedestrian signals and the poor condition of the pavement further reduce the safety and comfort for people walking.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted lines for the crosswalk are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Poor Road Surface
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement in the intersection can create trip hazards and affect vehicle handling.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time exposed to traffic without a refuge.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded parallel lines with continental (ladder) style markings to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked zebra crosswalk and a pedestrian signal, but is hampered by poor infrastructure quality. A wide grassy median provides some separation from opposing traffic, yet the sidewalk and roadway pavement are visibly degraded.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is cracked and uneven, creating a significant trip hazard for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground along the grassy area

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings are worn and fading, which reduces their visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, continuous, and ADA-compliant walking path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide roadway with a large grassy buffer separating the sidewalk from the street. However, there is a lack of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals at the visible intersection, creating a long and unprotected crossing distance for residents.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross an expansive roadway without designated space.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide road geometry requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian countdown signals to the existing traffic light infrastructure to provide crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial intersection with significant crossing distances and faded pedestrian markings. The environment is heavily prioritized for motor vehicle throughput, lacking visible pedestrian refuge islands or high-visibility crossing treatments.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center intersection crossing the main roadway

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing transverse crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection across the side street

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental or ladder-style markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.
